title: Time Triage and Question Selection
tagline: Year 4 — Classifying questions at first glance and spending time where marks per minute are highest

introduction.overview: Triage means sorting questions by how quickly they will pay marks. At a first glance, a question is quick (under 45 seconds), medium (about 90 seconds) or long (over two minutes). Marks per minute decide the order: all quick questions first, then medium, then long ones with whatever time remains. Triage turns a section from a sequence of questions into a time budget.
introduction.placementRelevance: Sectional timers in online tests make triage the biggest strategic lever.
introduction.realWorldContext: Prioritising tasks by value per unit time is the same skill.

learningObjectives: Classify a question at first glance
Plan a section as a time budget
Leave questions that fail the time test

prerequisiteKnowledge.quickRefresher: Marks per minute = marks ÷ minutes. A question is worth attempting while its marks per minute exceeds your average.

coreDefinitions: Budget: total time split across questions.
First pass: the quick and medium questions.
conceptExplanation.theoreticalIntuition: Every question costs time and pays marks; spend time where the rate is highest.
conceptExplanation.visualOrMentalModel: At first glance tag Q, M or L. Do Q, then M, then L if time remains.

mainNarrative: Take a 40-minute section with 30 questions: 12 quick (45 s), 10 medium (90 s) and 8 long (150 s). Quick items take 9 minutes, medium 15 minutes, long 20 minutes: a total of 44 minutes, which is 4 over. Skip about two long questions.
Marks per minute: a quick question gives 1 ÷ 0.75 = 1.33 marks per minute; a medium one 0.67; a long one 0.4.
If a long question has already used 4 minutes, its marks per minute has dropped to 0.25; leave it.
Plan checkpoints: after 10 minutes, the quick questions should be done.
If you finish the first pass early, spend time on the long questions you marked.

deepDiveAspects.title: Equal marks assumption
deepDiveAspects.content: If questions carry different marks, use marks per minute with the actual marks.

deepDiveAspects.title: Sectional timers
deepDiveAspects.content: You cannot carry time from one section to another; plan each section separately.
